name: Rapid Response Facility

funder.name: Rapid Response Facility (Fauna & Flora and UNESCO)

summary: Fast emergency grants to organisations responding to sudden, unforeseen threats to biodiversity at natural World Heritage sites, and occasionally other internationally recognised sites, in ODA-eligible countries.

geography.label: Countries eligible for official development assistance (OECD)

status.quote: Applications are accepted throughout the year, ensuring support is available whenever emergencies arise.

applicant_types.quote: The types of organisations we fund include (but are not limited to): Government bodies responsible for site management Registered local, national or international non-governmental organisations Private sector organisations

geography.quote: RRF grants are restricted to countries that are eligible for 'official development assistance' according to the OECD.

access.quote: Requests for funding are only accepted through submission of the official RRF online application form

window.quote: Applications are accepted throughout the year, ensuring support is available whenever emergencies arise.

amount.quote: Grants of up to $40,000 to respond to emergency situations in natural World Heritage Sites.
